title: DeleteWall Command
description: Delete one straight wall run, and the openings in it, then rebuild that host wall from its path. Wall records that touch are read as one shape, and the run is picked on it: side for an outer wall, or the face nearest at. The run is cut out of every record that shares it; a record the run covers goes whole. Taking a partition out joins the two rooms it parted; taking an outer wall out opens the ring. A wall standing on its own is deleted whole. Refused, with nothing changed: a delete that would leave a record in two separate pieces (not in this version), and one that would leave another opening past the end of its wall. The floor slab and flat roof from that record are rebuilt, and rooms are detected again. A shown daylight map is hidden as out of date. Id omitted uses the one selected wall, else the wall nearest at, else the only wall. Refuses X-EXIST.

id.description: Wall GUID. Omit to use the selected wall, or the only one.

side.description: The outer wall facing this way. Exclusive with at. Omit both when the selected wall is one run: that run is the wall.

at.description: [x, y] in mm on or beside the wall: the face nearest it, within 1000 mm. Exclusive with side.
